title: Spec/vector mismatch: SelectChannel epoch endianness
description: spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md line 394 says 'Epoch as BE u32 bytes' but test/vectors/ccp_select_channel_endianness.json uses little-endian (epoch.to_le_bytes(4)). The concatenated_data_hex values in vectors confirm LE (e.g., epoch=0x12345678 becomes bytes 78563412). Either spec text or vectors must be corrected for interop. P1 correctness.
close_reason: Fixed spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md line 394: changed 'Epoch as BE u32 bytes' to 'Epoch as LE u32 bytes'. Verified against Python oracle and test vectors.
